mode.splitDesc: Split tunnel — only subnets go through VPN
mode.fullDesc: Full tunnel — all traffic goes through VPN
mode.fullUnavailable: Full tunnel is unavailable while connections are active

hints: Check the pre-shared key (PSK) in the connection settings
The key must match the one configured on the server

ike_no_proposal.message: The server did not accept the encryption proposal
hints: The IKE parameters on the server do not match ours
Contact the server administrator to confirm the settings

ike_ts_unacceptable.message: The server rejected the tunnel subnets
hints: The server may only allow specific networks

ike_cert_untrusted.message: The server certificate or key failed verification
hints: The server uses a key that the application does not trust

ike_peer_unreachable.message: The server is not responding to IKE requests
hints: Check the server address and internet connectivity
A firewall or provider may be blocking UDP 500 and 4500
IPSec is established but the PPP tunnel did not come up
Check the session logs and the server settings

ppp_peer_auth_failed.message: The server failed authentication at the PPP stage
hints: The account is misconfigured on the server

ppp_our_auth_failed.message: The server rejected the username or password
hints: Check the login and password in the connection settings
Make sure the account is active on the server

ppp_peer_dead.message: The server dropped the PPP connection
hints: The server stopped answering channel echo requests
The pppd process was killed after start, check the session logs

stack_failed.message: The local VPN daemons failed to start
hints: charon or xl2tpd did not start
Restart the application; if it repeats, reinstall the helper
The cause of the failure is unknown, open the session logs

manage.title: Manage
manage.wsDeleteBody: All connections inside “{{name}}” will be deleted and cannot be recovered.
manage.connDeleteBody: The connection and all its data will be deleted and cannot be recovered.

settings.title: Settings
settings.configDesc: Export and import all connections and labels, including passwords. The file is encrypted with a password.
settings.labelsDesc: Fields for categorizing connections. Built-in labels cannot be deleted. Labels are shared across all workspaces. Connections and grouping are per workspace.
settings.updatesDesc: Check for a new version of the application.
settings.dangerDesc: Deletes all connections and custom labels. Built-in labels are kept. This action cannot be undone.
settings.exportBody: The file will be encrypted with this password. Without it the data cannot be recovered.
settings.importBody: Enter the password the file was encrypted with at export.
settings.resetBody: All connections and custom labels will be deleted. Saved passwords will be removed from the system keychain. This action cannot be undone.
